read tables

```{r}
# Read DE result tables from CSV.
# NOTE: Assumes these files exist and contain at least the columns:
# - 'rowname' (gene symbol) used later for filtering and labeling
# - 'log2FoldChange' (numeric)
# - 'pvalue' (numeric)
BE_vs_ctrl<-read_csv("results/tables/BE_vs_ctrl_mRNAonly.csv")
RJ_vs_ctrl<-read_csv("results/tables/RJ_vs_ctrl_mRNAonly.csv")
RJ_vs_BE<-read_csv("results/tables/OROV_RJ_vs_OROV_BE_mRNAonly.csv")
```

Protein coding genes

```{r}
# Annotate genes via Ensembl and keep only protein-coding ones.
# NOTE: biomaRt uses an internet connection to query Ensembl.
# If running offline or on a cluster without outbound access, this chunk will fail.
library(biomaRt)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

# Get gene annotation (Ensembl human)
mart <- useMart("ensembl", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")

# Retrieve gene name and biotype
gene_annot <- getBM(attributes = c("external_gene_name", "gene_biotype"),
                    mart = mart)

# Keep only protein-coding genes (by external_gene_name / HGNC symbol)
protein_coding_genes <- gene_annot %>%
  filter(gene_biotype == "protein_coding") %>%
  pull(external_gene_name)

# Filter each table to mRNA/protein-coding using 'rowname' column
# NOTE: Ensure your CSVs have a 'rowname' column with gene symbols.
BE_vs_ctrl_mRNAonly<-BE_vs_ctrl %>% filter(rowname %in%protein_coding_genes)
RJ_vs_BE_mRNAonly<-RJ_vs_BE %>% filter(rowname %in%protein_coding_genes)
RJ_vs_ctrl_mRNAonly<-RJ_vs_ctrl  %>% filter(rowname %in%protein_coding_genes)

# Export filtered tables as XLSX using WriteXLS (kept as-is)
# NOTE: WriteXLS requires Perl. If not installed, this will error.
WriteXLS::WriteXLS(BE_vs_ctrl_mRNAonly, "results/tables/BE_vs_ctrl_mRNAonly.xlsx")

WriteXLS::WriteXLS(RJ_vs_BE_mRNAonly, "results/tables/RJ_vs_BE_mRNAonly.xlsx")

WriteXLS::WriteXLS(RJ_vs_ctrl_mRNAonly, "results/tables/RJ_vs_ctrl_mRNAonly.xlsx")
```

Plot volcano

```{r}
# Genes to highlight on volcano plots (labels)
genes_to_mark <- c( "SAXO2",    
           "CCDC83", "ITGAM", "ITGAL", "DOCK8", "IL18", "CCL5", 
           "HNF1A", "SLC22A10",  "CD22",  "PDE6A", "RHAG", "TNNT2", "SHFL", "CYP26A1", "LSM6", "RGS16")

library(EnhancedVolcano)

# Example filter (not used later; kept as-is)
higherthan2<-RJ_vs_BE_mRNAonly %>% filter(log2FoldChange > 2)

# Volcano: RJ_vs_BE_mRNAonly (FC cutoff = 2)
# NOTE: EnhancedVolcano expects columns 'log2FoldChange' and 'pvalue' present.
EnhancedVolcano(RJ_vs_BE_mRNAonly,
    lab = RJ_vs_BE_mRNAonly$rowname,
    x = 'log2FoldChange',
    y = 'pvalue',
    FCcutoff = 2,
    selectLab = genes_to_mark,
    col = c('grey', 'grey', 'grey', 'salmon'),
    drawConnectors = TRUE,
    ylab = "p value",
    title = "RJ_vs_BE",
    subtitle = NULL, 
    labSize = 3, 
    titleLabSize = 18)

# Save volcano plot (kept path and size)
cowplot::ggsave2("Plots/Volc_OROV_RJ_vs_OROV_BE_f.pdf", height = 6, width = 7)
```
